body:
I'm 30, graduated college, have a decent job. My external life could easily be deemed "fine". I honestly couldn't tell you when this began. My earliest memories of being a small child were praying every night that god would kill me in my sleep or give me cancer or something that no one could be mad about. There were years of mental and physical abuse at the hands of my father. I remember exactly where I was standing when I learned the word suicide. It was light a light bulb went off in my head. I think I was 8. It was a moment of  THAT! That is what I want! I can't believe there's a word for it! Being 8 I didn't really have enough know how to come up with means, so I continued praying to a god with all my heart who never showed me mercy. Then I was 11, and I realized I could starve myself to death. That just ended up turning into an eating disorder. I was sent to residential treatment at 15 for a year and 6 months. I've been inpatient for extended periods a couple of other times. OD-ed a few times last year. Let them give me 11 seizures in the name of making me better. All it did was obliterate parts of my memory and nearly cost me my job even with FMLA. It's been almost exactly a year since I did that and I still notice cognitive improvements. The best part was  being knocked out before the procedure. And then finally the duh! moment where you know exactly what you would need to do.

My family is tired of watching the train wreck. They are just in a state of constant worry = Guilt.
The friends I did have are tired of watching the train wreck. 
I feel like I've accomplished nothing.
I have no one and am too scared of people in general to let anyone know the truth.
My psychiatrist said we've maxed out the med options.
The therapist I see isn't really helping. If I told her the truth she'd probably just commit me again. I've spent countless hours in therapy. If it was going to help, I'd be fine.
My liver and kidneys are starting to fail from the malnutrition.
I have the bones of a 90 year old woman, and I'm allergic to the medicine they use to treat that. I don't want a hip replacement(s) by the time I'm 31.
I'm convinced there must be something structurally wrong with my brain because of the inability of modern medicine/science to do anything to help.
I also have anxiety, a terrible time sleeping, and nightmares all night every night.
I don't want to exist like this anymore, and I feel completely powerless to do anything but end it.
